component.name: Gsub
component.summary: Edit, transform, and proofread SRT and ASS/SSA subtitles

description.p: Gsub is a modern subtitle editor for the GNOME desktop, built with GTK 4 and libadwaita. It edits, transforms, and proofreads SRT and ASS/SSA subtitle files, with a libmpv video preview, a precise timeline with an optional audio waveform, and a visual editor for ASS override tags.

Highlights: byte-exact SRT/ASS round-trip fidelity, undo/redo for every edit, a visual override-tag editor (font, colours, position), semantic style inputs, batch operations across many files, subtitle-track extraction from video files, encoding auto-detection, and a compatibility checker that flags and fixes common ASS problems.
